scope.sourceGraphRule: Current explicit candidate references first, plus their live selected assembly/selection/base source lineage. Explicit generation-origin/guide snapshots were read only as cited provenance; archival external caches, historical configs, prior selections and unsaved old receipt diagnostics are excluded from current dependency counts. No unreferenced historical image search.
scope.modelPolicy: 2026-10-13 root AGENTS clarification: prefer free/included GPT Image 2.5; existing built-in 2.0 allowed if unavailable; no extra paid routes. This audit generates nothing and never infers actual model from requested model.

countDefinitions.referenceOccurrence: One current-required JSON sourceDocument + JSON pointer occurrence, including source/evidence artifacts; repeated paths count once per pointer. Does not count map tiles or native outputs produced.
countDefinitions.confirmedOccurrence: Within current_required only: single resolved file exists, declared SHA256/dimensions match when provided and no attached native-box/header mismatch. This confirms the audited snapshot reference, not a full repository migration, visual approval, native provenance replay, or map completion.
countDefinitions.uncertainOccurrence: Within the same current_required set: missing/ambiguous path or a declared SHA256/dimension/native-box mismatch. File existence is separate from metadata certainty. Newer changes listed in inputChangesAtEnd remain unvalidated.
countDefinitions.uniqueFiles: Case-insensitive resolved current-required path, deduplicated across all occurrences.
countDefinitions.historicalExclusion: Previous snapshot/selection/prior-file references are not current missing deliveries and are not opened.
countDefinitions.nativePositionEvidence: Explicit boxes are recorded per occurrence and checked against file header only where a native box is directly attached. No pixel replay or visual seam inspection performed.
countDefinitions.archivalExclusion: Original tool cache paths and old preparation config/contract snapshots describe origin; same-hash saved local source pairs are provided. Missing archived config or unsaved output receipt is not a missing current tile. No deleted paths were restored.
countDefinitions.portability: Absolute D:/work/image strings are classified from the original text and mapped to portableRepoPath in this independent report. Original owner manifests remain unchanged and require root substitution or a later owner-managed relative-path version on another computer. External cache locations are not called portable.
